messages:
Dana (sales): quick sync: AcmeCorp POC — console shows requests but Datadog traces not linking; logs have a header field called trace_hdr instead of trace_id, and they're getting bursts of 429s under load.
Ibrahim (solutions): thanks. can you paste a raw log line + any headers captured? are you using datadog-forwarder or the splunk drain?
Sana (acmeops): using datadog-forwarder. raw line: 
2026-03-21T18:02:11Z INFO request path=/v1/generate status=200 latency_ms=78 trace_hdr=00ab12cd34ef56... request_id=""
headers captured: Authorization, Content-Type, X-Real-IP
Ibrahim (solutions): two things: 1) our system expects W3C traceparent header or a JSON field named trace_id; 2) 429s likely due to concurrent testers without backoff.
Eli (obs-eng): quick repro: send a curl with traceparent; our API will echo x-redwood-trace. sample: curl -i -H 'traceparent: 00-ab12cd34ef56ab12cd34ef56ab12cd34-abcdef1234567890-01' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
Sana (acmeops): tried it, response had x-redwood-trace: ab12cd34ef56ab12cd34ef56ab12cd34. after that our logs show trace_id populated.
Eli (obs-eng): good. Fix options: a) update your client to forward traceparent b) configure the forwarder to map trace_hdr -> trace_id (ensure value is 32 hex chars) c) add retry+backoff for 429s or request temporary burst quota.
Dana (sales): can we get a burst for the demo tonight?
Eli (obs-eng): opened INC-8633 to grant short burst to project acme-poc until 2026-03-24. observability-bot: Export changed: datadog-forwarder-acme (ndjson) 
Ibrahim (solutions): Sana, please add mapping rule: copy trace_hdr -> trace_id and confirm in Datadog by searching trace_id:<hex>. also reduce concurrency or add jitter to your load test.
Sana (acmeops): mapping applied, verified trace linking in Datadog, and throttling the runner cut 429s by ~90%. thanks all.
Dana (sales): awesome, closing this POC thread unless anything else comes up :)
